2022_235_dec_2021_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction report for December 2021 itemizes every district card charge and credit posted under the journal entry description "DEC PCARD EXP," with each line showing transaction date, merchant, budget unit and account code. Printed 2/10/2022 and carried on the February 15, 2022 Board of Education agenda, the twenty-page listing closes with a subtotal of 187,611.73 in charges against 6,645.81 in credits and Total Expenses of 180,965.92. The largest single line is a 9,848.09 Staples order (STAPLS734097, dated 11/29/2021) charged to budget unit 101204261647000, account code 6410.

**Format**
